newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says BOJ survey shows economy recovering.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says BOJ survey shows economy recovering.

text.p: The Bank of Japan's survey of corporate sentiment released last week supports the view that Japan's economy is gradually recovering, Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Monday.
Hashimoto was speaking in an address to parliament, which convened last Friday.
The BOJ released its quarterly "tankan" survey last Wednesday. The survey showed big Japanese manufacturers grew somewhat cheerier about their business prospects in November.
